ready.title: Ranking rule — RUNNING out-of-sample read (converted 2026-08-18 from a single 2026-10-15 gate)
ready.action_when_ready: RUNNING READ — fires again every session a new out-of-sample alert_date lands, from the first one. Every run: state n (COUNT(DISTINCT alert_date) WHERE alert_date > 2026-08-16) and its confidence label via `scripts/alert_rank_shadow_running_read.confidence_label` — n<25 is THIN/directional, NEVER presented as a verdict; n>=25 is DECISION-GRADE. Score catch-rate on the tail first (>=10R), medians second. Read the EOD version against the as-of-09:45 version separately (full-day tightness vs ORB-time-only — different questions). Report BOTH directions per quartile (winners admitted, losers admitted/excluded — see `score_both_directions`), never a winner count alone. Validates -> selection is actionable and the plan's sufficiency target stops depending entirely on conversion; does not -> the plan narrows to conversion alone.
